parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, small in size, and ergonomically shaped for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle, allowing the user to adjust the output.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switch, channels water from the inlet to the outlet, and provides stability when mounted on a sink.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed during operation, serving as the stationary base for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved in shape, and designed to direct water flow into the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the internal channel to the sink, often designed with an aerator to control flow and reduce splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water to different areas of the sink.
